messages:
Maria G.: heads-up — customer reports GPU nodes flapping in their VPC after our kernel 6.1 -> 6.4 + CUDA 12.2 rollout. They pasted `nvidia-smi` error: 'NVMLError: Driver/library version mismatch'.
Ajay K.: ugh. saw a faint signal in staging but didn't follow up. sounds like driver vs DKMS rebuild problem?
Ivan (cust): we installed vendor OEM driver 525 via DKMS on our images. after the kernel upgrade the modules didn't rebuild and nodes went NotReady. node-exporter shows NVML errors.
Leo T.: can you paste `dkms status` and `modinfo nvidia` output? also, is this fully on-prem in their VPC (customer-managed images) or our managed image?
Ivan (cust): `dkms status` -> nvidia, 525: added
Ivan (cust): `modinfo nvidia | grep -i version` -> 525.85.05
Ivan (cust): `dmesg | tail -n 6` -> "modprobe: could not insert 'nvidia': Exec format error"
SRE-Jen: Exec format error usually = kernel/module ABI mismatch. if DKMS couldn't recompile against 6.4 headers, the module is incompatible. customer kernels + OEM drivers are a known edge.
Maria G.: options: 1) recommend customer run DKMS rebuild + install matching kernel-headers on their AMI and reboot, or 2) rollback our kernel rollout for that private pool/region to avoid on-customer reboots. rollback buys time but stalls security upgrades.
Ajay K.: capacity question: if we rollback, which private pools are affected? eu-west-2 dedicated pool is already tight. OpsBot, what's the impact?
OpsBot: OpsBot: region eu-west-2 dedicated GPUs: 72/80 healthy. rollback candidate pool `private-vpc-euw2-3` contains 6 nodes. Rolling back would restore node kernel to 6.1 for that pool and affect 3 tenants.
Leo T.: important note — NVML ABI mismatch also breaks our telemetry -> health-checks mark nodes unhealthy which triggers autoscaler churn. that's why pods get evicted repeatedly. we should avoid immediate cordon on NVML errors while investigating.
Ivan (cust): rebuilding DKMS is fine with us if you can provide a tested script. we tried `sudo dkms autoinstall` but it fails during build on custom initrd.
SRE-Jen: action items: Ajay to coordinate rollback decision + customer comms; Maria to share DKMS rebuild steps and test script for Ubuntu22.04 + custom kernel; Leo to add a temporary guard to node health check to ignore transient NVML errors for 30m.
Ajay K.: I'll loop in Support and Product. decision window 2h, otherwise we schedule rollback for the pool to prevent further customer-impact.
Maria G.: I'll DM Ivan the DKMS script and request logs. also logging a note: update supported matrix doc to mark "OEM driver + DKMS on customer-managed kernels" as a special-case that requires rebuild and may be unsupported by default to reduce future disputes.
OpsBot: OpsBot: created incident INC-2026-314; added tags: `nvml`, `dkms`, `kernel-rollback-planning`."
